nonclaims: This review does not qualify the Darwin or Linux OS provider.
The prior incomplete live-provider receipt remains fail-closed and is not converted into an absence result.
No policy02 source was activated, copied into canonical controls, admitted, or used for a production/native06 attempt.

prior_probe.qualification_blocker: The saved probe had a native proc_pidinfo short read for PID 10491, also present in the middle ps table. Policy02 adds diagnostics but does not resolve that provider failure; provider completeness and historical absence remain unestablished.

details: The Darwin CDLL is loaded with use_errno=True; errno is cleared before proc_listallpids, each proc_pidinfo call, and proc_pidpath.
Short reads and native API errors preserve provider/API, PID, returned count, expected size, and ctypes errno; identity-change and path errors retain bounded observed details.
Diagnostics propagate to both snapshot.error and coverage_errors.
All native API failure paths remain errors; no skipped PID, retry, historical absence, or complete observation is emitted.
native_qualifier.py and process_reconciliation.py remain byte-identical to policy01; only snapshot_query.py, focused tests, README, and handoff changed.
The handoff remains private-source-prototype-only-native-probe-still-blocked and explicitly says no policy02 live provider probe or qualification was run.
The inherited synchronous receipt-writer limitation remains disclosed; no hard end-to-end wall-time claim is made.
Introduces independent 64 KiB ps row and argv caps; leaves native MAX_COMMAND_BYTES at 4,096 bytes.
Preserves the 8 MiB aggregate ps table, 8,192 PID, parent stream, and existing absolute time limits.
The raw table and structured rows remain the same classifier input; no truncation, filtering, or row omission is added.
Tests accept an exact 9,239-byte editor-like argv and assert byte-identical raw table delivery to both frozen classifiers; tests reject over-64-KiB rows/argv and aggregate output over 8 MiB.
